title: Colorimetric paper-based test strip for detection of methylparaben in nonconforming health care products
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24752-24760
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00484A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aya M. El-Hassanein, Sherin F. Hammad, Fotouh R. Mansour, Aya A. Abdella
Fe3+ immobilized on chitosan-modified cellulose paper was used as a test strip for rapid, cost-effective methylparaben quantification in pharmaceutical products via concentration-dependent color change and smartphone-based color analysis.
